name: Yujie Zhu
weekly_overview: This week, I developed forecasts for Medicaid enrollment and expenditure data. For enrollment, I applied Prophet and a policy changepoint model; for expenditure, I used Holt’s damped trend method. I also incorporated CHIP data and completed state-level forecasting work for New York, Illinois, Pennsylvania, and Washington.

progress: Medicaid Enrollment Forecasting: Applied Prophet and a policy changepoint model to forecast enrollment trends, incorporating CHIP data into the analysis.
Medicaid Expenditure Forecasting: Used Holt’s damped trend method to project expenditure trends. Completed state-level analyses for New York, Illinois, Pennsylvania, and Washington

next_steps: Extend the enrollment and expenditure forecasts to the national level. Add written explanations of the forecasting methods, key trends, and results to support interpretation of the analysis.
